SELECT deal_id AS id, workspace_id, deal_id AS parent_id, user_id FROM deal_collaborator WHERE (workspace_id, deal_id, user_id) > (#{cursor.workspaceId}, #{cursor.parentId}, #{cursor.userId}) AND (workspace_id, deal_id, user_id) <= (#{watermark.workspaceId}, #{watermark.parentId}, #{watermark.userId}) AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY workspace_id, deal_id, user_id
SELECT id, workspace_id, id AS parent_id, owner_id AS user_id FROM company WHERE id > #{cursor.id} AND id <= #{watermark.id} AND owner_id IS NOT NULL AND owner_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, workspace_id, id AS parent_id, owner_id AS user_id FROM deal WHERE id > #{cursor.id} AND id <= #{watermark.id} AND owner_id IS NOT NULL AND owner_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, workspace_id, id AS parent_id, owner_user_id AS user_id FROM workflow_intervention WHERE id > #{cursor.id} AND id <= #{watermark.id} AND owner_user_id IS NOT NULL AND owner_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, workspace_id, id AS parent_id, owner_user_id AS user_id FROM campaign WHERE id > #{cursor.id} AND id <= #{watermark.id} AND owner_user_id IS NOT NULL AND owner_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
